purpose: Cross-language fixture for independent protocol_version and schema_version semantics.

expected_semantics.protocol_version: must be supplied by the frozen normative protocol specification; this fixture intentionally does not invent its value
expected_semantics.schema_version: identifies the canonical object schema/representation version
expected_semantics.implementation_versions: must not be substituted for either field

canonicalization_requirement.rule: Both version fields, once normatively bound, are resolved before canonical serialization.
canonicalization_requirement.digest_domain: The resulting canonical bytes are consumed by the DQ-002 canonical hash-domain model.
canonicalization_requirement.algorithm: SHA-256(0x00 || canonical_bytes) for a leaf; SHA-256(0x01 || left[32] || right[32]) for a node.

conformance_assertions: RI-PY and RI-RS MUST interpret protocol_version and schema_version as distinct fields.
Neither implementation may derive protocol_version from Core or Guard package version.
Changing schema_version must not silently change protocol_version.
Changing protocol_version must be treated as a protocol-contract change.
An unsupported protocol_version must not be silently downgraded or reinterpreted.
closure_blockers: Initial authoritative protocol_version value is not yet frozen.
Canonical serialization inclusion/order of both version fields is not yet normatively frozen.
